description: Verifies that sector scans do NOT populate port knowledge for trade routes

tests.name: Fixture: clear the player's prior port knowledge

data.sql: DELETE FROM player_known_ports WHERE player_id = (SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name = 'scan_player')

tests.name: Rig: Choose a connected two-way port pair

data.sql: SELECT p1.port_id, p1.sector_id, p2.port_id, p2.sector_id FROM ports p1 JOIN sector_warps sw ON sw.from_sector = p1.sector_id JOIN sector_warps back ON back.from_sector = sw.to_sector AND back.to_sector = sw.from_sector JOIN ports p2 ON p2.sector_id = sw.to_sector AND p2.port_id > p1.port_id WHERE p1.is_active AND p2.is_active ORDER BY p1.port_id, p2.port_id LIMIT 1

tests.name: Fixture: configure a two-way ORE market on the selected ports

data.sql: WITH selected AS (SELECT port_id FROM ports WHERE port_id IN (@{scan_origin_port_id}, @{scan_target_port_id})), normalized AS (UPDATE port_trade pt SET mode = 'buy' FROM selected s WHERE pt.port_id = s.port_id AND pt.commodity = 'ORE' RETURNING pt.port_id), inserted AS (INSERT INTO port_trade (port_id, maxproduct, commodity, mode) SELECT DISTINCT port_id, 1000000, 'ORE', 'sell' FROM normalized RETURNING port_id) SELECT count(*) FROM inserted
UPDATE players SET sector_id = @{scan_origin_sector} WHERE name = 'scan_player';

tests.name: Teleport active ship to selected origin sector

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id = @{scan_origin_sector} WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'scan_player');

tests.name: Warp to the adjacent port sector
Route Request (Still Empty - Scans shouldn't add knowledge)
Dock at the adjacent port (Now we know 1)
Warp back to selected origin sector
